description: Port of Townsville Quarterly Awarded Contracts Report is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Port of Townsville. As per the QPP 2026 the Port of Townsville is required to publish awarded contracts valued at $10,000 and above. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Port of Townsville. Its tags are Contract Disclosure Report. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
